title_q: Thank You, Clayton and the Sachs Family
headline: A personal thank-you to Clayton and the Sachs family from the clinic floor: two boys going into surgery today, two girls back a year later and doing what they love.
story: Mackinnon greets Clayton and the Sachs family from Clínica Noel.
Two boys go into surgery today. Two girls came back a year after theirs, and now they can just be kids and dream big.
Thank you from the bottom of her heart. Come along someday.

Caption “The transformation is amazing.” with no “And”, and keep “and I can't thank”.
Out after “Thanks. Ciao.”, then the light watsi.org card.
dont: No name super, no title, no logo at the start.

transcript:
Auto-transcript of Mincho5119.MP4 (Medellín, Clínica Noel, 28 Jul 2026), Mackinnon's thank-you to Clayton and the Sachs family. Times are mm:ss.s in the file, from the word timings. Fixed by hand: Watsi (transcript: WOTC), Clínica Noel (transcript: Clinic Unwell), Sachs (transcript: SACS).

--- Mincho5119.MP4 ---
[00:02.4] Hola Clayton.
[00:03.8] Hi Sachs family.
[00:05.1] I'm here at Clínica Noel in Colombia.
[00:08.3] We're having the most amazing day meeting patients, hearing their stories.
[00:12.6] We've met two young boys who are going in for surgery today and two chicas, two girls who came back from having surgery last year so we could see how they're doing and the transformation is amazing.
[00:25.2] They're going from you know kids who had a lot of pain and weren't able to do things that they love to do to now being able to do whatever their heart wants and just really be a kid and dream big about what's ahead.
[00:37.1] So I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart.
[00:39.3] It's been so cool to get to know you over the last year and I can't thank you enough for showing up for Watsi and making all of this possible.
[00:46.4] It'll be fun to come with me someday so let's talk about that next time I see you.
[00:51.9] Thanks.
[00:52.5] Ciao.
